rows.role_title: President of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: A statement dated 20 January 2019 is headed "STATEMENT BY PRINCE MANGOSUTHU BUTHELEZI MP PRESIDENT OF THE INKATHA FREEDOM PARTY", and in it he says "I have been asked to lead the campaign as the Party's President".

locator.section: Heading block and the paragraph containing "I have been asked to lead the campaign"

rows.role_title: President of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: In the same statement he recalls intentions "which I expressed to a meeting of our Extended National Council in October 2017", that "I would not stand for re-election to the position of Party President at the next elective conference".

locator.section: Paragraph beginning "The structures of our Party were well aware"

rows.role_title: President of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: The statement says the Extended National Council decided that day to engage the election campaign before holding conference: "We now know that conference will take place immediately after the 2019 elections".

locator.section: Paragraphs beginning "But the unanimous decision taken today" and "We now know that conference will take place"
